points.text: Visiting the Prophet Muhammad, his father Ali, his brother Hasan, and his son Husayn, whether during their lives or after their deaths, guarantees Paradise.

Visiting the Prophet, his progeny, or specifically Ali and his two sons ensures that the Prophet guarantees the visitor's deliverance from the terrors of the Day of Resurrection and places them in his rank.
Visiting the Prophet or any of his progeny results in the Prophet visiting the visitor on the Day of Judgment and saving them from its terrors.
Visiting the Prophet, his father, his brother, or himself creates a duty upon the Prophet to visit the visitor on the Day of Judgment and clear them of their sins.
